final_message:
`RESULTS.json` written. Summary:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Quarterly revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Quarterly costs | €467,940 |
| Quarterly net | €765,285 |
| Margin | 62.1% |
| Net customer adds | 153 (69 + 52 + 32) |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% (956 / 1,001) |
| June growth | +4.6% |
| July growth | −9.6% |

One data issue flagged in `notes`: the **June cost table doesn't reconcile** — its line items sum to €158,540 but the report states €158,240 (a €300 gap). I used the line-item sum, since the itemized breakdown is the source data and the total line is derived from it; May and July reconcile exactly. This makes quarterly costs €467,940 rather than €467,640 had the stated June total been used.

The notes also record the operational picture the numbers paint: July revenue dropped after June growth, and net adds decelerated each month as churn climbed (17 → 22 → 31).
